izakaya.name: The Public Izakaya 2
izakaya.summary: The second Public Izakaya, opened in 2014 about 75 metres from the flagship, with a large outdoor seating area. It serves the same broad izakaya menu and is suited to groups of up to 20.

izakaya.name: The Public Izakaya Nitengo
izakaya.address: 10 Hoe Chiang Road, #01-06, Keppel South Central, Singapore 089315
izakaya.summary: The newest outlet (2025), set beside Hachi Restaurant's relocated home at Keppel South Central. It has indoor and outdoor seating and the same wide izakaya menu and Japanese drinks list.

izakaya.name: Robata Akari
izakaya.summary: An open-kitchen robatayaki on Duxton Hill built around a central irori hearth where seafood, vegetables and meat are slow-grilled over charcoal. The Peak singles it out for its limited-quantity charcoal-grilled blackthroat sea perch, so reservations are recommended.

source.title: Robata Akari official site (hours 5pm-12am, last order 11pm); also The Peak, Best Izakaya Singapore

izakaya.name: Neon Pigeon
izakaya.summary: A Keong Saik-area Japanese restaurant inspired by izakayas, with a moody industrial look and a bar listed as a 50 Best Discovery Bar. It turns out playful small plates and sake and cocktails, and is celebrating ten years of operation.

izakaya.name: Issho Izakaya
izakaya.address: Marina One The Heart, 5 Straits View, #01-03, Singapore 018935
izakaya.summary: A modern, waterfront-facing izakaya and sushi bar in the Marina One CBD cluster, good for after-work rounds that turn into dinner. It is known for flame-grilled kushiyaki, sashimi platters and ice-cold sake.
dishes: Sashimi platter of five belly cuts
Miyazaki A5 with Foie Gras Miso

izakaya.name: Izakaya Hikari
izakaya.summary: A relaxed, unfussy izakaya on level 3 of Fortune Centre in Bugis, popular with students and office workers for affordable Japanese comfort food. Rice bowls, grilled items and small plates pair with sake, beer and highballs.
izakaya.hours: Mon-Fri 12pm-2:30pm, 5:30pm-10:30pm (hours differ slightly between sources); Sat dinner; closed Sunday per one source
